items.difficulty_reason: 6 行陈述（51 行证明）、域扩张基变换分支的重数为 1 或特征方幂：char 0 完全化归约、char p 化为极小素处 artin 环长度、纯不可分 pushdown 下降、可分/纯不可分分解加光滑局部化、长度沿平坦局部同态搬运。5 处引用全具名（Varieties 1 + Algebra 4），无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-multiplicities-field-extension (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 304-309

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Handle the characteristic zero case by perfectness and geometric reducedness, translate the positive characteristic case into a statement about lengths of artinian local rings at minimal primes of the tensor product, descend along finite purely inseparable extensions using the pushdown formula for modules and the fact that the induced residue field extensions have p-power degree, split the extension into a separable part over a finite purely inseparable part via the make-separable lemma, observe the purely inseparable tensor product is an artinian local ring whose length is a p-power by the previous step, factor the separable part as the localization of a smooth algebra so the ring in question is a localization of a smooth algebra over the artinian local ring at a minimal prime, and transport the length along the flat local homomorphism with matched maximal ideals using the pullback formula for lengths (source lines 311-361)
